name: io.github.mw-jeong/agentsumo-mcp
description: MCP server for LLM-driven SUMO traffic simulation, scenario design, and result analysis.
title: AgentSUMO

environmentVariables.name: SUMO_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the local SUMO installation directory (must contain bin/, share/, tools/).

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSUMO_MCP_OUTPUT_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for simulation outputs (networks, trips, results). Defaults to the current working directory.
